text:
Kara Liu: postmortem follow-up — we captured remediation items but didn't assign owners for runbook safe-checks, escalation matrix, and recurrence tracking. who can take these?
Devon Hale: I can own the runbook safe-checks. target: Fri EOD.
Omar Singh: I'll update the escalation matrix + paging thresholds. aiming for Wed.
Priya Nair: I'll add recurrence tagging automation, saved filter, and a grafana tile. target: Tue.
Kara Liu: perfect. please paste the exact doc paths so I can link them in the postmortem tracker. also include a tiny eval in PRs (MTTI before vs after).
Devon Hale: runbook path: docs/runbooks/ops/safe-checks.md
Omar Singh: escalation doc: docs/runbooks/escalation/paging-matrix.md (diagram in drawio attached to PR)
Priya Nair: recurrence playbook: docs/playbooks/recurrence/recurrence-guidelines.md and dashboard: infra/grafana/dashboards/recurrence-count.json
Devon Hale: sample safe command snippets I'll add to the runbook: ```
# check p95 for model
rwinfctl metrics get --model=embed-main --window=5m | jq '.p95'
# dry-run route change
rwinfctl router set-route --route=embed-main --model=embed-fallback --weight=100 --dry-run
# apply when confirmed (idempotent)
rwinfctl router set-route --route=embed-main --model=embed-fallback --weight=100
```
Omar Singh: paging proposal: extend transient window for p95 alerts from 5m -> 8m and add pre-page validation: "confirm spike not from batch job". i'll stage in canary and report results.
Priya Nair: recurrence tagging: label recurrence:yes and field recurrence_count. saved search: "recurrence:yes AND created>=-30d". will add grafana panel "recurring_incidents_count" and link to playbook.
inc-bot: created TASK-6222 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TASK-6222) "Runbook/escalation/recurrence followups" assigned to Devon, Omar, Priya. due dates set per thread.
sre-oncall: noted. will add the grafana panel and test threshold change in staging.
Kara Liu: please open PRs and paste links here. include a short eval plan: MTTI delta (1 week before vs after) in PR description.
Devon Hale: draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/432 — includes test plan and MTTI check.
Omar Singh: PR with updated matrix + diagram: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/435
Priya Nair: recurrence automation PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/210 — saved filter + dashboard included.
Kara Liu: i'll update the postmortem action tracker and set reminders. can we schedule a biweekly "recurrence review"? priya, can you own invites?
Priya Nair: invite sent for "recurrence review" biweekly. template and agenda added to the playbook.
Devon Hale: note — i'll include "confirm steady-state for 60s" before any rollback and keep commands idempotent.
Kara Liu: awesome. i'll close TASK-6222 after owners confirm PRs merged and the tiny eval looks good. thanks everyone. :checkered_flag:
